digest.component_or_area: rebar metrics command and agent-lifecycle instrumentation
propositions: rebar lacks an aggregation layer to surface agent-driven dev loop trends and code-health metrics over time across three lenses (agent loop health, codebase decay, gate ROI)

three tier-C blindspots leave no durable trace in the event store: env/integration-diagnosis intervals, bug provenance (which prior change caused this bug), and bug outcome classification (regression vs plan-defect vs flaky)

auto-derived caused_by edges via blame must bypass the closed-source guard and be labeled best-effort non-authoritative, with explicit --caused-by override always winning and skipping when blame cannot resolve a single commit
the --class enum on bug close replaces (not supplements) the required free-text reason to keep bug-close friction flat at exactly one required argument
snapshot series must be git-tracked at .rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson rather than reports/ to prevent silent gitignore loss
the rebar metrics command must register all available metrics, emit structured unavailable state for metrics without yet-accrued signals, and support dynamic date-range filtering with JSON output
